04 / FULL-STACK PRODUCT CASE STUDY

CareerConnect.

A two-sided hiring platform with job-seeker and employer workflows spanning a React frontend and Express/MongoDB backend.

CareerConnect is a full-stack hiring platform organized around two distinct user journeys. Job seekers can browse and filter roles, view job details, save jobs, submit applications, manage profiles, and track application-related information. Employers can post openings, manage jobs and applicants, update company or profile details, and access application-oriented analytics. The frontend uses React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router, Axios, and Framer Motion, with protected-route and authentication-context structure. The backend uses Node.js, Express, MongoDB with Mongoose, JWT authentication, bcryptjs, and Multer. Repository routes and controllers cover authentication, users, jobs, applications, saved jobs, and analytics, illustrating an end-to-end REST product workflow across frontend and backend layers.
